description: Vanguard Total International Stock ETF tracks the FTSE Global All Cap ex US Index, providing broad exposure to thousands of stocks across both developed and emerging markets outside the United States. At an expense ratio of 0.05%, it is one of the cheapest instruments for international diversification. The fund's trailing price-to-earnings ratio (around 14 as of mid-2026) makes it a notable valuation counterweight to higher-multiple U.S. equity funds.
